equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim statement of financial position, 30 June 2026 (1277.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt:1020). Deducted once here; flows are consolidated.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue CAGR from the volume build (Dafanpu flat at mid-cycle price; Yong'an 1.2mt + Weiyi 0.9mt + Makhado ramp consolidated 2027-29; 2% thereafter) -- not the equity CAGR, which was accumulated during the FY2021-22 coal supercycle and says nothing about forward volumes
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-yr CAGR 24.2% diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (12.3%) and EPS (1.8%) 5-yr CAGRs: equity compounded on retained supercycle earnings of FY2021-22 while EPS has round-tripped to FY2018-20 levels. Every CAGR here spans a full coal cycle (trough FY2020 -> peak FY2022 -> trough FY2025) and is point-to-point noise; the base case is built from volumes and a mid-cycle price, not from any of them.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF less SBC (nil before FY2025; RMB18.6m in FY2025); interest income never deducted because the company has never held net cash above 1x its FCF base. Owner-FCF CAGRs are ~0.5pp below reported because SBC appeared only in FY2025 -- SBC is not yet a growing share of cash flow, but the Jan-2025 awards (RMB34.3m expensed in H1 FY2026 alone) mean it will be through FY2027.

scenario_narratives.base: Dafanpu keeps selling ~7-8mt/yr of branded 5,000 kcal thermal coal at a mid-cycle ASP of roughly RMB680-700/t (between the FY2025 trough of RMB603 and FY2024's RMB752; H1 FY2026 printed RMB694). The 'anti-involution' safety-driven supply tightening supports H2 2026 prices but is not extrapolated into a new supercycle. Yong'an (1.2mt coking) reaches official production in H1 2027 and Weiyi (0.9mt) in H2 2027-2028; Makhado ramps, but only to about two-thirds of the guided 2027-28 volumes given the commissioning history (flooding, Eskom grid), and MC Mining stays funded by Kinetic's loans and subscriptions. Consolidated EBITDA margin normalises from 46% in FY2026 to 41%, below the Dafanpu-only historical average because the real-estate/agriculture/tobacco segments remain a drag and the coking mines and South Africa earn lower margins. Capex runs at 16%/12%/9% of revenue over FY2026-28 then 6% sustaining. Thermal coal's structural decline caps terminal growth at 1% nominal and the terminal multiple at 12x FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: The post-Shanxi-accident safety regime and reduced Indonesian exports keep the domestic market in deficit for several years; Dafanpu's ASP returns to and holds near FY2024's RMB750/t with unit costs continuing to fall (H1 FY2026 -9-12% YoY), lifting the coal-segment margin back toward 60%. Yong'an, Weiyi and Makhado all hit guided timelines, Makhado reaches its 2.2mt coking + 1.8mt thermal capacity by 2028 and MC Mining's going-concern issue is resolved by production cash flow, so consolidated revenue roughly doubles by FY2029 and the group becomes a diversified thermal-plus-coking producer with a 45% mature margin. The ancillary businesses mature to break-even. Terminal growth 1.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Domestic coal prices give back the H1 2026 rally and settle at or below the FY2025 trough (~RMB600/t) as supply quotas normalise and steel/cement demand keeps contracting, so Dafanpu revenue falls in FY2026-27 and margins sit near FY2025's ex-impairment ~37% before drifting to 33% as the loss-making ancillaries persist. MC Mining's going-concern doubt crystallises: Makhado never reaches nameplate, Kinetic funds further emergency loans and subscriptions (capex 13% in FY2027) for little revenue, and the RMB1.19bn of NCI recognised on consolidation is matched by equally impaired assets. Yong'an and Weiyi slip a further year, and the RMB1.35bn of related-party acquisition prepayments remain unrecovered. Terminal growth 0% reflecting thermal coal's structural decline in a China decarbonising faster than assumed.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A coal miner is valued on mid-cycle cash flow, not on the latest half. FY2025 was the trough and H1 FY2026 a near-peak half; the base case sits between them on price, haircuts every guided volume ramp, carries the ancillary losses permanently, caps the terminal at 12x FCF with 1% growth for thermal coal's structural decline, deducts the MC Mining minority at book, and gives zero value to RMB1.35bn of related-party acquisition prepayments. Risk is charged once: in the scenario flows and a 30% bear weight, not in a scenario-specific WACC.
valuation_philosophy.sanity_check_response: The Step 8c implied-multiples check tripped on P/E only (20.7x printed vs a 6.0x 10-year average; P/B, EV/EBITDA and P/Sales inside their historical ranges). Two-thirds of that figure is denominator: the check divides the IV by FY2025 EPS, which is the cycle trough (ASP RMB603/t, -20% YoY) and carries ~RMB400m of ancillary impairments -- H1 FY2026 alone earned 86% of FY2025's full-year profit. On the base case's FY2026E net income (~RMB1.5bn, consistent with H1 FY2026 annualised) the base IV implies roughly 9-10x and the market price roughly 8-9x. The printed figures are also ~17% too high on both the implied and historical sides because the script divides an HKD value by CNY per-share earnings (ratio-invariant, so the trip test is unaffected). The remaining, genuine signal is that even a ~9-10x normalised P/E is roughly double what the market paid for this company in FY2018-24, and the price sits at 90% of its 10-year range. That gap is about who owns the cash flow, not how much of it there is, so the fix is in the discount rate, not the flows: WACC raised from 10.0% to 11.5% in all three scenarios (+1.0pp single-mine concentration, +0.5pp governance / connected-party capital allocation / free float), with the growth, margin, capex, tax and terminal paths left exactly as built. This does not clear the script's rule -- nothing short of an IV below ~HK$1.24 (12x trough EPS) would, which would assert the shares are worth a third less than the market price in the half-year that profit doubled -- so the residual trip is recorded as a trough-denominator artifact rather than iterated away. Investment framing: a mid-cycle commodity producer whose upside needs a re-rating the market has only paid for in the last 18 months; the weighted IV is at or below the price, so the return is the coal price and the mine ramps, not multiple expansion.
key_risks_to_valuation: Coal price: every RMB50/t on Dafanpu's ~7.5mt is roughly RMB375m of revenue and, at ~27% cash tax, ~RMB270m of owner FCF (~HK$0.04/share/yr capitalised at 12x = ~HK$0.45/share) -- the single dominant sensitivity

MC Mining / Makhado: going-concern doubt at the 51% subsidiary; the base case assumes continued Kinetic funding and a partial ramp. Failure removes the Makhado revenue in FY2027-29 but also leaves the RMB1.19bn NCI deduction (which would then be overstated) -- the bear case carries this
Ningxia coking mines (Yong'an, Weiyi): timelines have slipped at each report; a further year's delay is ~RMB1bn of FY2027 revenue

Related-party acquisition prepayments (RMB1.35bn to Guizhou Liliang / Seedland entities) and the ancillary real estate, agriculture and tobacco ventures: capital allocation outside the core, impaired in FY2025, carried at zero here

Liquidity: net current liabilities of RMB239m at 30 June 2026 and directors' going-concern wording now conditional on operating inflows and bank access; a RMB1.0bn net-debt position is low (gearing 9%) but rising
Structural thermal coal decline and PRC safety/environmental regulation: both the terminal growth (1%) and the 12x cap embed this; a faster policy shift is the bear terminal of 0%
FX: CNY flows against an HKD quote; a 5% CNY move is ~5% on every HKD value in this file and refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fix_applied: Step 8c.5 fix #2 (structural WACC premium), 2026-10-16. Trip: implied P/E 20.7x vs 2x the 10yr average 6.0x; P/B, EV/EBITDA, P/Sales in range. Diagnosis: (1) the P/E denominator is FY2025 EPS, the cycle trough with ~RMB400m of ancillary impairments -- H1 FY2026 alone earned 86% of FY2025's profit, so on base-case FY2026E net income (~RMB1.56bn, consistent with H1 annualised) the pre-fix base IV implied ~10x, not 20.7x; (2) all printed multiples are ~17% high on both sides because an HKD value is divided by CNY per-share figures (ratio-invariant); (3) the genuine residual is that even ~10x normalised is ~2x what the market paid in FY2018-24 and the price is at 0.90 of its 10yr range -- a discount-rate issue (single mine, chairman control, RMB1.35bn connected-party prepayments, free float), not a flows issue, since margins (41% settled vs 50% history) and growth are already below history. Change: WACC 10.0% -> 11.5% in all three scenarios (+1.0pp single-asset/region concentration, +0.5pp governance/free float; cyclicality premium deliberately NOT added because it is already charged in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight). No driver path changed. Result: base IV HK$2.14 -> 1.77, bull 3.11 -> 2.56, bear 1.11 -> 0.91, weighted 2.03 -> 1.67 (upside +11.9% -> -7.9%). Residual: the script's rule still trips at 17.1x because the denominator is unchanged; clearing it would need an IV below ~HK$1.24 (12x trough EPS), i.e. asserting the shares are worth a third less than the market in the half-year profit doubled. Recorded as a trough-denominator artifact; not iterated further per the one-fix budget.

implied_multiples_after_fix.basis: script basis: base IV on FY2025 actuals, SBC-adjusted, HKD value over CNY per-share (printed ~17% high)
implied_multiples_after_fix.normalised_basis: base IV HK$1.77 over base-case FY2026E EPS ~HK$0.21 (net income ~RMB1.56bn = EBITDA 2,508 - D&A 245 - SBC 65 - net interest ~65, taxed 27%; H1 FY2026 actual RMB768m annualises to 1,537); EV RMB15,403m over FY2026E EBITDA less SBC RMB2,442m. Like-for-like vs the printed 6.0x / 3.8x averages: 1.65x and 1.7x the 10yr average, inside the 2x rule; price HK$1.81 is 8.6x the same EPS.

inputs.share_count_basis: 8,599.508m shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) at 30 June 2026 per H1 FY2026 interim report (post the 10 June 2026 placing of 169.508m shares at HK$1.85), plus ~118m treasury-stock-method dilution from 263.5m unvested awarded shares (purchase price HK$1.00, vest 6 Jan 2028) at the HK$1.81 price -- consistent with the interim's 115m dilutive effect (8,547.6m diluted vs 8,432.2m basic weighted). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows, so compounding the count would charge the awards twice. The 10% scheme mandate (579.5m shares still available) is unissued and not counted.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Equity-settled share-based payment expenses' RMB18,611k (1277.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:5625); no equity-award cash taxes disclosed (net-share settlement not used). H1 FY2026 SBC RMB34.3m annualises to ~1.3% of revenue, which is the forward anchor.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 nil; H1 FY2026 RMB23.9m of repurchases (treasury shares) against a RMB269.2m placing in the same half -- the company is a net issuer, so the flat count is a modelling convention, not something buybacks are funding.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1731 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X on 2026-10-16; cross-checked USDHKD 7.8472 / USDCNY 6.6862 = 1.1736 and 1/HKDCNY 0.8516 = 1.1742. Direction check from the company's own 10 June 2026 placing note: HK$313.6m gross proceeds = RMB272.8m, i.e. 1.1496 HKD per CNY at that date (CNY has since strengthened ~2%). No dual listing exists for a parity check. All flows and per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by fx_rate to HKD; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD to match current_price.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T07:21:12Z (15:21 HKT, intraday during the HKEX regular session)
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 interim: bank loans and other borrowings RMB1,452.4m (current 535.0 + non-current 917.4, includes RMB70.4m of MC Mining borrowings consolidated from April 2026) + lease liabilities RMB48.8m (28.8 current + 20.0 non-current) - cash and cash equivalents RMB456.2m = RMB1,045.0m. Restricted deposits pledged for notes payable and bank loans are excluded from cash. Net debt rose from RMB248m (FY2024) to RMB790m (FY2025) to RMB1,045m (H1 FY2026) on mine construction, the MC Mining subscription and RMB1,346m of acquisition prepayments.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10-year government bond ~1.9% + China/HK equity risk premium ~6.5% x beta ~1.1 plus a ~1pp premium for a small-cap HKEX coal miner with thin coverage gives a cost of equity ~10.5%; after-tax cost of debt ~3.5% (bank loans 4.2-5.8% pre-tax, 25% PRC rate) at ~10% debt weighting gives a base WACC of ~9.8%, rounded to 10.0%. SANITY-CHECK PREMIUM (Step 8c.5 fix #2, 2026-10-16): +1.5pp of explicit structural premia on top, to 11.5%, because the 10-year multiple history (P/E 2.2-5.7x, EV/EBITDA 0.9-4.1x across FY2018-24) shows the market has never capitalised Kinetic's earnings at ordinary coal-miner multiples, and the reasons are discount-rate items the scenario flows do not carry: (i) +1.0pp single-asset / single-region concentration -- one producing mine (Dafanpu, Inner Mongolia) supplies ~85-88% of revenue, so one geological, safety or licensing event is the whole company; (ii) +0.5pp governance and free float -- chairman-controlled, RMB1.35bn of prepayments to connected parties, the June 2026 placing, and a minority holder's limited claim on how surplus cash is deployed. NOT added: the template's extreme-cyclicality premium (EBITDA peak-to-trough 3.3x would qualify) because coal-price cyclicality, the MC Mining going-concern risk and mine-ramp execution are already charged in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight; charging them again in the rate would double-count. The same 11.5% is used in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt: RMB48.8m of lease liabilities are inside net_debt; lease principal is NOT deducted from the flows; ongoing lease-asset renewal is immaterial (total leases <1% of EV) and absorbed in the capex_pct_path.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are modelled on a consolidated basis (MC Mining consolidated from April 2026, Makhado ramp inside the revenue path) and the non-controlling interest is deducted ONCE in the equity bridge at its 30 June 2026 book value of RMB1,227.9m (interim statement of financial position line 1020; RMB1,187.6m of it recognised on the MC Mining business combination). Smaller NCI in the real-estate and tobacco subsidiaries is inside the same figure. Not also leaked from the flows.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF, cyclical adaptation (SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical'), 10-year horizon because the margin and capex profile is still normalising through the Yong'an/Weiyi/Makhado ramps. Kinetic is a single-producing-mine Inner Mongolia thermal coal miner (Dafanpu, branded 5,000 kcal low-sulphur 'Kinetic 2', ~85-88% of revenue), with two Ningxia coking coal mines in trial/construction, a 51%-controlled South African coking/thermal project (Makhado, via MC Mining) that started production in August 2026, and loss-making ancillary real estate, agriculture and Cambodian tobacco businesses. MID-CYCLE NORMALISATION: FY0 = FY2025 is the cycle trough (EBITDA margin 30.0% on ASP RMB602.8/t, -19.9% YoY, and ~RMB400m of ancillary impairments inside the segment loss); FY2021-22 were the supercycle peak (EBITDA margins 62-63%, revenue RMB5.6-6.2bn); the FY2018-FY2025 average EBITDA margin is 50.2% on a Dafanpu-only mix. The base case does NOT extrapolate the H1 FY2026 rebound (ASP RMB694/t +17.6%, gross margin 52.6%, coal-segment EBITDA ~59%): FY2026 is set at a 46% consolidated margin and the path settles at 41% from FY2030, i.e. below the historical average to reflect (i) the permanent drag of the ancillary segments, (ii) lower-margin ramping coking mines and South African logistics/Eskom costs, and (iii) the structural long-run decline in thermal coal pricing (terminal growth 1.0% nominal CNY). INTEREST INCOME: FY2025 RMB14.0m is left in the flows; the company is net debt, so there is no cash pile to double-count. TAX: cash tax rate 27% flat (cash taxes paid were 30%/22%/31%/24% of PBT in FY2025/24/23/22; PRC statutory 25% plus non-deductible items and 10% PRC withholding on dividends repatriated to the Cayman parent; South Africa 27%). WORKING CAPITAL: wc_capture -5% of the revenue change -- receivables and coal inventory grow with the mine ramps, partly offset by the large and lumpy customer prepayment balance (contract liabilities RMB820m at H1 FY2026). EXCLUDED FROM THE BRIDGE (conservative): RMB1,346.0m of prepayments for proposed acquisitions (Guizhou Liliang coal capacity, Seedland-related properties -- connected transactions) are carried at zero because they are non-producing, partly related-party and not yet recoverable as cash; if the acquisitions complete, their value arrives through the revenue path, and if they unwind as cash this is ~HK$0.18/share of upside. Restricted deposits also excluded. The June 2026 equity placing (RMB269.2m net) is already inside the share count and cash. Guidance (H1 FY2026 interim, 24 Aug 2026): coal prices expected to keep rising in H2 2026; Yong'an official production start H1 2027 at 1.2mt/yr; Weiyi H2 2027 to full capacity 2028 at 0.9mt/yr; Makhado 2026 ~0.51mt clean coal rising to 1.6mt in 2027 and 4.0mt within two years; Sierra Leone rutile first output Oct 2026.

bear.narrative: Prices fall back to the FY2025 trough; Makhado stalls under MC Mining's going-concern strain; Ningxia mines slip again.

base.growth_note: FY2026: H1 revenue +0.4%, H2 helped by rising domestic prices and ~5 months of Makhado (0.51mt clean coal in 2026) -> +3%. FY2027: Yong'an 1.2mt coking coal at full production plus Makhado 1.6mt consolidated, Dafanpu volumes flat at a mid-cycle ASP ~RMB680-700/t -> +12% (a haircut to the ~+20% that full guided volumes would imply, for the record of slipped timelines). FY2028: Weiyi 0.9mt and further Makhado ramp -> +8%. Thereafter 2-4%: no further Dafanpu volume growth, nominal coal price drift only, thermal coal in structural decline.
base.margin_note: FY2025 trough 30.0% (incl ~RMB400m ancillary impairments; ~37% ex-impairment). H1 FY2026 consolidated ~52%, coal segment ~59% -- a near-peak half. FY2026 46% assumes H2 prices hold but the full-year carries ramp-up losses at Yong'an/Makhado. Settles at 41%: below the 50.2% FY2018-25 Dafanpu-only average to carry the loss-making ancillaries, lower-margin coking mines and South African cost structure permanently.
base.sbc_note: Jan-2025 awards (263.5m shares, 3-year vest to Jan 2028) are expensing at ~RMB70m/yr = 1.2-1.3% of revenue through FY2027, then a lower run-rate of replacement grants.
base.capex_note: FY2026 ~RMB880m (H1 actual RMB480.9m; commitments RMB656.7m at 30 June: Weiyi construction, Makhado, coking coal preparation plant, rutile JV). Normalises to a 6% sustaining-plus-development rate (FY2018-20 mature-Dafanpu run-rate was 3-4%; FY2023-24 with new mines 8-10%). D&A converges on 5.5% as the new mines depreciate.
base.narrative: Mid-cycle Dafanpu plus a haircut ramp of the three new mines.

bull.narrative: Supply-side tightening holds prices near FY2024 levels; all three mines ramp on schedule.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% (house default 15%) because the newly consolidated 51% subsidiary MC Mining disclosed going-concern doubt at its June 2026 year-end with ~US$2.9m cash and has already needed emergency loans and a further subscription, the Ningxia mine timelines have slipped at every report, RMB1.35bn of connected-party acquisition prepayments sit on the balance sheet, and the core product is a commodity whose FY2025 price fall cut net profit 57% in one year. Bull cut to 20% because it needs four independent things to go right at once: prices holding at FY2024 levels, all three mine ramps on time, Eskom/logistics in South Africa, and the ancillary segments stopping their losses. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.weights_note: Weights are a judgment, recorded here so the next update can see what was assumed rather than re-deriving it.
